{{EventEnd|date=12th of June 2026}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = BackyardLegendsPI.png |dates = 22 May 2026 – 12 June 2026 |acts = 3 |act_name = Missions |previous_event = [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass|Spring Frenzy]] |next_event = TBA }} ==Description== '''Backyard Legends Event''', sometimes referred to as the '''adidas Event''', was an event where Tower Defense Simulator collaborated with adidas [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mJJY53qhJe0 Backyard Legends], with the three main characters of the event being from there. It brought in only five new skins, two obtained for beating all maps on Easy difficulty and Hard difficulty, and also three [[Mission Quests]]. The event maps contained three unique modes, each with an Easy and Hard difficulty. The event began on the 22nd of May 2026, and ended on the 12th of June 2026. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:AdidasMission1Background.png|200px|link=Backyard Beginnings]] |[[File:AdidasMission2Background.png|200px|link=Competition Court]] |[[File:AdidasMission3Background.png|200px|link=Victory Field]] |- |[[Backyard Beginnings]] |[[Competition Court]] |[[Victory Field]] |} ==Skins== ===Triumph=== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:CrewDemomanIconIG.png|175px|link=Demoman/Gallery]] |[[File:RefereeCommanderIconIG.png|175px|link=Commander/Gallery]] |- |[[Demoman/Gallery|{{Color|Backyard|Crew}} Demoman]] |[[Commander/Gallery|{{Color|Backyard|Referee}} Commander]] |- |All maps on Easy |All maps on Hard |} ===Mission Quests=== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:CrewAssassinIconIG.png|175px|link=Assassin/Gallery]] |[[File:CrewTrapperIconIG.png|175px|link=Trapper/Gallery]] |[[File:SuperFanMilitantIconIG.png|175px|link=Militant/Gallery]] |- |[[Assassin/Gallery|{{Color|Backyard|Crew}} Assassin]] |[[Trapper/Gallery|{{Color|Backyard|Crew}} Trapper]] |[[Militant/Gallery|{{Color|Backyard|SuperFan}} Militant]] |} ==Enemies==
